messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — cutover for hotpatch HF-7120 scheduled in ~45m. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PRs/7120 needs two sign-offs before the window. Small change (config bump + fallback) but we need two independent eyeballs. can anyone spare a quick review?

tess: On my calendar, will take a look in ~10. can you paste the exact diff you want me to focus on?

alex: Thanks — main thing is the routing fallback in runtime/serve/router.py (4 lines). diff excerpt:```diff
-   if not route_found:
-       return default_model
+   if not route_found:
+       # fallback to cheap-variant to avoid 503s
+       return default_model_variant
```

alex: Also test matrix: `make smoke` and `pytest tests/integration/test_routing.py::test_fallback` — locally +1 failing flake which i've fixed in latest push.

jamal: I'm on-call but can do a quick skim. if it's the tiny fallback you pasted looks fine. will run the smoke now.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks complete for PR #7120 — CI ✅  coverage ok, lint ok, can-deploy: true

alex: pushed a tiny tidy after the CI run (fix docstring). requesting review from @tess and @jamal — this is blocking the hotpatch window.

tess: reading... ok code looks harmless, would prefer an explicit comment about Variant semantics. left 1 inline comment.

jamal: smoke passed locally, no e2e regression. :thumbsup: posting LGTM now.

tess: saw your docstring fix, resolved my comment, LGTM from me as well. :white_check_mark:

alex: Awesome — that's 2x signoffs. I'm going to merge and kick the cutover in 5. tagging oncall: @oncall-sched please standby for rollout.

oncall-sched: Copy — slot reserved. I'll run the cutover checklist and watch latencies, ping if rollback needed.

alex: Merge done, rolling hotpatch HF-7120 now. thanks y'all for the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (env=prod, region=us-west-2). monitor link: https://monitor.redwood/infr/deploys/7120

oncall-sched: Observability green so far, tracing looks good, will keep eyes for 30m.

alex: Closing thread — will open postmortem only if we see regressions. :raised_hands:
